summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Partner system overhaul (Iteration 4). All 19 backend API tests passed (100%). All 10 frontend UI tests passed. Key changes verified: Partner removed from navbar (kept in footer), registration now requires password, login works with phone+password or phone+OTP, forgot password flow with OTP reset, scroll-to-top on route change.
passed_tests: Navbar does NOT have 'Partner' link - only shows Home, Our Services, Collaboration, Sales
Footer has 'Partner Program' link pointing to /partner/login
Scroll-to-top works on footer link navigation (scroll position 0 after click)
Partner landing page shows 'Become a Partner' and 'Partner Login' buttons
Partner registration form has: Full Name*, Mobile Number*, Email (Optional), Password*, Confirm Password*
POST /api/partner/register accepts name, phone, password with optional email
POST /api/partner/verify-otp creates account and returns token (auto-login)
Partner login form has phone+password fields, 'Forgot Password?' link, 'Login with OTP' button
POST /api/partner/login-otp sends OTP for phone-based login
POST /api/partner/login-otp-verify verifies OTP and returns token
POST /api/partner/reset-password-confirm resets password with OTP verification
Full flow: Register -> OTP verify -> auto-login -> dashboard access
Full flow: Login with password -> dashboard access
Full flow: Login with OTP -> dashboard access
Full flow: Forgot password -> reset -> login with new password
